description: Rang Ghar (Assamese: ৰংঘৰ) is Asia's oldest surviving amphitheater, located 3 km from Sivasagar town in Assam, India. It sits next to the historic Rupahi Pothar (or Rupahi Pathar) field.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
